t: 一宋朝舰队在晋-宋会战中与晋朝舰艇在长江上进行海战.
te: A Song dynasty fleet fights a naval engagement with Jin dynasty ships on the Yangtze river during the Jin–Song Wars.
dz: 开西会战:一宋朝舰队在晋-宋会战中与晋朝舰艇在长江上进行海战.
de: Battle of Caishi: A Song dynasty fleet fights a naval engagement with Jin dynasty ships on the Yangtze river during the Jin–Song Wars.
